events.name: Green Bay Packers at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford threw three touchdown passes and the Detroit Lions beat the turnover-prone and short-handed Green Bay Packers 35-11 Sunday in a matchup of teams out of the playoff race.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford's 3 TD passes lift Lions to 35-11 win over Packers

headlines.description: Chuck Pagano wanted one more win as Indianapolis Colts coach. Now Pagano must wait to see if it will be his final victory with the team.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts beat Texans 22-13 in finale as waiting game begins

headlines.description: Minnesota's defense turned in another dominant performance and Latavius Murray rushed for 111 yards and two touchdowns, helping the Vikings secure a first-round bye for the playoffs with a 23-10 victory over the Chicago Bears on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings get to 13-3 for playoff bye by beating Bears 23-10

events.name: New York Jets at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Dion Lewis ran for a touchdown and caught a scoring pass, helping the New England Patriots clinch home-field advantage throughout the playoffs as the top seed in the AFC with a 26-6 victory over the New York Jets on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lewis scores twice, Patriots secure home-field with 26-6 win

events.name: Washington Redskins at New York Giants

headlines.description: Two-time Super Bowl MVP Eli Manning threw a touchdown pass in what might be his final game with the Giants and New York got a rare taste of winning with an 18-10 decision over the Washington Redskins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Giants close dismal season with 18-10 win over Washington

headlines.description: Dak Prescott tossed a 20-yard touchdown pass to Brice Butler early in the fourth quarter and the Dallas Cowboys beat playoff-bound Philadelphia 6-0 on Sunday, preventing the Eagles from a franchise-record 14th win.
The Cleveland Browns joined the 2008 Detroit Lions as the only teams in NFL history to go 0-16 when they failed to find a way to beat the backup-laden Pittsburgh Steelers in a 28-24 loss on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Woe and 16; Browns go winless after 28-24 loss to Steelers

headlines.description: Matt Bryant kicked five field goals, including a 56-yarder, for all of Atlanta's second-half points and the Falcons clinched a playoff spot by beating the Carolina Panthers 22-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons clinch playoff spot, beat Panthers on Bryant's 5 FGs

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: Patrick Mahomes II made both his first NFL start and his first NFL relief appearance a success Sunday, leading the Kansas City Chiefs past the Denver Broncos 27-24 on Harrison Butker's 30-yard field goal as time expired.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes leads Chiefs past Broncos 27-24 in 1st start

headlines.description: Marcus Mariota threw a touchdown and used his legs to help the Tennessee Titans end an eight-season playoff drought by beating the Jacksonville Jaguars 15-10 Sunday to clinch an AFC wild-card berth.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans beat Jaguars 15-10, end playoff drought with AFC spot

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: Jimmy Garoppolo threw for 292 yards and two touchdowns to lead the San Francisco 49ers to their fifth straight victory, 34-13 on Sunday against a Los Angeles Rams team resting its big stars for the playoffs.

The Buffalo Bills snapped the longest current non-playoff drought in North American pro sports with a 22-16 victory Sunday at Miami and Cincinnati's victory at Baltimore. The Bills hadn't made the postseason since 1999.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills end 17-year playoff drought with win and help

events.name: Oakland Raiders at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: Philip Rivers passed for 387 yards and three touchdowns, but the Los Angeles Chargers missed out on a playoff berth despite their 30-10 victory over the Oakland Raiders on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers rout Raiders 30-10, but playoff chase falls short

headlines.description: Phil Dawson kicked four field goals, the last from 42 yards with 2:21 left, Blair Walsh missed a 48-yard attempt with 32 seconds left and the Arizona Cardinals beat the Seattle Seahawks 26-24 on Sunday to close the season.

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Jameis Winston threw for 363 yards, including a 39-yard scoring pass to Chris Godwin with nine seconds remaining, to help the Tampa Bay Buccaneers snap a five-game losing streak with a 31-24 victory over the New Orleans Saints.
headlines.shortLinkText: Winston throws late TD pass, Buccaneers beat Saints 31-24

headlines.description: The Baltimore Ravens were ousted from the playoff hunt in stunning fashion Sunday when Andy Dalton threw a 49-yard touchdown pass to Tyler Boyd with 44 seconds, giving the Cincinnati Bengals a 31-27 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bengals oust Ravens from playoff hunt with 31-27 victory
